pr_title: Fix osu!taiko input drum alignment for old skin versions
pr_body:
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/8609.
- Bumps default skin version in line with what it probably should be.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/78775298-f3e12b00-79d0-11ea-9817-ee9eea903b69.gif)

review_comments: An inline comment can be added here pointing out why `LATEST` const isn't used instead.
i think it's pretty obvious. DefaultLegacySkin is basically constants from stable. if it requires a comment then we might as well just use LATEST and rename it to LAST_VERSION.
